text:
alex: Hey all — fresh hire here, trying to run the repo locally on Windows (WSL2). docker compose starts but my app gets `could not connect to server: Connection refused` when trying to connect to Postgres. Compose has postgres + redis services. Any common WSL2 gotchas?

Maria G: Welcome! :wave: WSL2 has network surprises. Quick Qs: is the app running in a container or on the host? paste your compose snippet if you can.

alex: App is in a container. It tries to connect to `postgres:5432` (service name). Compose snippet:
```yaml
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:14
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: example
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  redis:
    image: redis:6
  web:
    build: .
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:example@postgres:5432/dbname
volumes:
  pgdata:
```

Samir: Looks normal. If both are containers, service name DNS should work. If app is on host, `postgres` won't resolve.

alex: I `exec` into web and run `pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432` — it sometimes times out. `docker ps` shows postgres up. Postgres logs say "database system is ready to accept connections" then soon after `FATAL: database "dbname" does not exist` when web connects.

Jordan (ops): depends_on doesn't wait for readiness. Add a healthcheck to postgres or have web wait with `pg_isready` in entrypoint. Also watch volume permission errors on Windows mounts; check `docker logs` for postgres for any crash loops.

alex: Added wait loop: `until pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432; do sleep 1; done` in web entrypoint. pg_isready now reports ready, but app still reports intermittent Redis connection refused.

Maria G: For redis, ensure app uses `redis` hostname not `localhost` when running in container. Also verify no `network_mode: host` or custom host networking is set.

alex: Ah I had REDIS_HOST=localhost by mistake. Changed to `redis` and everything boots locally now. Good to go :tada:

Samir: Nice. Recommend adding a short README section for WSL2: run from WSL shell, avoid host networking, add healthchecks/wait-for for DB init, and use service hostnames for inter-service connections.

devbot: Reminder: please open a tiny PR updating onboarding README with the WSL2 tips and compose healthchecks. :memo:
